ground_rules_addendum: Rule 6 (added 02b): no text enters a manuscript in the past tense describing work not performed, including in templates. Placeholders read [NO DATA YET - Session NN].
Ordering constraint (added 02b): no additional evidence channel (video, audio, physiological, scraped) is added until D-19 is fixed and the guard REFUSES rather than silently degrading.
Rule 7 (added 02c): no number enters a manuscript unless a file in the repository produces it AND the person writing the sentence has run that file.

Ground rule 8 (Session 14): no citation enters a manuscript unless it has been confirmed against a live source and carries a resolvable identifier. Failure to confirm is reported as failure, never filled in from memory.
Ground rule 9 (Session 15): no instrument is administered whose permission terms are unconfirmed, and no item text is bundled with the software. An unconfirmed licence is a refusal, not a warning.

Ground rule 10 (Session 15): nothing about a person enters a model unless that person declared it or self-completed the instrument it came from. Absence is not refusal — a refusing method must exist and explain itself.

Ground rule 11 (Session 17): nothing is recorded as pending until a search for a public dataset, free instrument, third-party service or methodological substitute has come back empty. The pending list is the residue of a search, not a wishlist.

session_09_results.r1_critical: With the physiological stream enabled Shadow Mirror is plausibly an emotion recognition system under AI Act Art. 3(39), because Art. 3(34) biometric data does NOT require unique identification (unlike GDPR Art. 4(14)). Art. 5(1)(f) prohibits emotion inference in workplace and education institutions; in force since 2 Feb 2025.
session_09_results.r2_critical: Educational deployment evaluating learning outcomes falls under Annex III(3)(b) high-risk; obligations apply from 2 August 2026 (eight days after this session). Workplace equivalent is Annex III(4)(b).
session_09_results.session6_correction: WITHDRAWN: the Session 6 recommendation to pilot in education because it is low-stakes. Under EU law education is a named high-risk and potentially prohibited domain. Literature synthesis is promoted to the Phase 3 pilot; Session 15 reframes to individual adults using the self-mirror outside any institution.
session_09_results.safety_exception: Art. 5(1)(f) excepts systems intended for medical or safety reasons. The physiological stream exists solely as a threat confound and its removal raises the misreading rate to 31.2%. That is a clean safety-purpose argument but it is untested and must be stated as an argument, not a conclusion.
session_09_results.r3_consent: The consent gate meets 5 of 7 dynamic-consent criteria and exceeds two (unbundleable non-obvious streams; may_reveal disclosure). Gaps: no append-only consent record (Art. 7(1)); no withdrawal receipt (Art. 7(3) parity).
session_09_results.prohibited_use: Rewritten with enforcement tags: 5 of 12 prohibitions enforced in code and tested, 7 policy-only. P-4 (emotion inference in workplace/education) is the only prohibition that is illegal to breach in the EU and has no code mechanism.
session_09_results.gdpr_art9: Self-reported emotion and physiological arousal can both be data concerning health under Art. 9(1); lawful basis is explicit consent Art. 9(2)(a), which the per-stream gate provides. The monograph does not currently cite Art. 9.
session_09_results.tension: The physiological stream exists only to protect people and provably does, and it is precisely what pulls the system into the emotion-recognition prohibition. That belongs in the paper as a section.
